native_literal_emission_fix: Coalesce recognizes literal ir.Undefined and ir.Null as absent without comparing constant sentinel addresses. Moved non_null_initialized.ts and default-boxed-write.ts exposed the clang warning; both now run. TestNonNullLiteralUnionInitializers pins both literals and catches no-check mutants by stdout.

native_package_existing_failure.reason: Both candidate and clean 337aa466 fail to link the same unchanged runtime sources: missing adamic_write_raw, adamic_share, adamic_stack_thread_start and adamic_heap_thread_end. Other completed native tests pass; this unrelated failure is left unchanged.

intermediate_failures: Migration exposed constant NULL-versus-adamic_null comparison in C for literal assertions stored into a union; fixed in check emission, preserving fixture bytes.
A test-only const-never interpolation hit an unrelated NotYet; the added union-emission probe uses a normal subsequent assignment instead.
A liveness filter selecting only three definite-declaration programs hit its non-vacuity guard; the final whole flow suite passes.
Root disk exhaustion interrupted one final count-table check while saving gate-cache results. Discarding only reproducible Go-cache artifacts allowed the complete resolved check to pass.
source_policy: Runtime programs use .ts. Only deliberate .a refusal controls are excluded from flow and runtime counts. Definite declarations retain readiness; ordinary initializer assertions stop eagerly.
limitations: The full repository gate, census replay and scanner slice were not run.
The complete native package retains the proven pre-existing DecodeASCII/native linker failure.
The lazy-initializer drop-check mutant prints additional output before a later existing hoisted-var readiness panic; it is caught by stdout alone, without relying on that later panic.
delivery: One additional own commit and one push to codex/non-null-checked-next only; no main or area branch changes.
